Gallery (72 frames)

Ranked defects

  1. Overcast and fog keep the clear-day royal-blue sky (frames 19-24, 25-30). Mechanism: js/lighting/atmosphere.js:444-465 (overcast) and :466+ (fog) only recolour the horizon, and only when raceTimeOfDay === "default"; unlike wet/rain/storm they never call _dayWetGreyDeck() (defined :607, used :431/:442). Captures used explicit --tod day, so zenith stays [.09,.26,.95] (:237). Shared engine, affects every circuit at explicit day. Fix: blend the zenith toward the grey deck in the day overcast (~0.7) and fog (~0.5) branches. Not applied (read-only).
  2. Conifers dominate; the brief's Pannonian planting (poplar rows, airy akác) is a minority. Every eye frame 61-72 and most orbit frames show layered pines/spruce. Cause: scenery/hungaroring.js:261-275 forestEdge pineFrac 0.32-0.55 on 7 passes, plus pine() in the 6 pairs at :753-760; the 5 poplar windows (:56-62) cover only 0.075-0.150, .245-.320, .470-.545, .665-.745, .840-.905. Fix: pineFrac ≤ 0.08, drop pine() at :759, widen poplar windows.
  3. T1 / Pit-Exit cluster stands on the start straight, not at T1. Authored 0.07 / 0.10 / 0.12 (:195-204, accents :236-238, hillsides :603-604, billboard :539, kerbs :541) land at racing 0.973 / 0.003 / 0.023 (authored + 0.9029); T1 apex is 0.0898, ≈ 380-510 m further on. Frame 01 shows a two-tier stand beside the start gantry. The brief admits this ("Not re-keyed"). Tyre wall red :335 (authored .045-.075 → racing .948-.978) is on the pit-entry straight, not the T1 braking zone. Fix: key through au(def.turns[0]) / sl(). Arithmetic from the measured shift; not otherwise confirmed.
  4. Hills read as hard pyramids and flat-topped plateaus. Visible in frames 03, 04, 07-12 (green pyramid right of the road at f50). Cause: peak() ring (:150-154), 14 mid-ring addCone mounds with 7 sides (:176-183) and 12 box backdrop() amphitheatre blocks (:163-172). Contradicts the brief's "rounded green mounds". Fix: lower/soften peaks, build mounds with terrain or many-sided domes.
  5. Wet/rain/storm: foliage ghosting and mirror-like verges. Frames 10, 16, 26-30: tree crowns show vertical-stripe / see-through shading and the off-road ground reflects the trees like standing water; rain streaks are sparse. Mechanism not isolated (wet material reflection applied to FOLIAGE/terrain, or screen-space reflection) — hand to renderer-debug/lighting-tuner. The day-wet-lighting merge itself works: day rain/storm no longer look like night.
  6. Lamps render on a def with lamp:"none", night:false; dressingExclusions do not stop bespoke emitters. Bare halogen poles are in the daytime frames (e.g. 67, 68, 70) and lit pools at night/dusk. Cause: :286-325 authored lampPost + clusters; the def's lamp:'none' only suppresses the engine mast pass (js/track/scenery/build-props.js:2275) and dressingExclusions are applied to generic dressing (:1399-1423). Low: either remove the 4 emitters or make the def say what the scenery does.
  7. Night/dusk lit grass is blocky and flat-yellow. Night frames show stair-stepped mottled lit patches; dusk frames 2 and 6 have a flat yellow wash over the verges and a thin horizontal streak across the sky near the sun. Likely terrain resolution/lamp-pool shading and a sky-shader sun glare; mechanism unconfirmed.
  8. Mid-lap stands are in the authored frame, not tied to corners. Stands 0.40 / 0.55 (:218-221), terraces (:674-676), jumbotron (:680), towers (:691-693) land at racing ≈ 0.303 / 0.453 / 0.253 / 0.583 / 0.703 — plausible but not matched to the labelled corners in the brief table. Low; documented frame debt.
  9. Cottage roof × tree cone, 1.34 m (clip baseline). :705-715 cottages vs generic trees at authored frac 0.608; baseline-capped, no render evidence. Low.
  10. Frame 01 stand is sparse rails only. The +1 T1 stand shows seat rows as thin rails without roof or crowd from the orbit view; mostly an LOD/crowd-density observation (grandstandEx at :195). Low, uncertain.
